exclusions.nativeDescription: We are hiring bug bounty hunters in our pentesting team at Appsecure Security. I'd rather have three people who chase the bug nobody else found than ten who run a scanner and file the output. So this is a research role, not a checklist role. Who we're looking for: → 2–3 years as a security engineer or pentester → Someone who goes deep on complex security research, not surface-level findings → 1000+ reputation on HackerOne or Bugcrowd → OSCP or CRT certified What we're offering: → Fully remote, work from anywhere within India or Singapore → Very fast-paced & competitive learning env → Pay above market standard → Best-in-class health insurance for you → Real engagements, and the freedom to go deep on the targets that interest you How to apply: email me at careers@appsecure.security with 2–3 pieces of the best research you've done — write-ups, disclosed reports, CVEs, a blog post, whatever shows how you think. Skip the generic resume drop. I read the research first. Know someone who'd be a fit? Tag them below. #bugbounty #hiring #pentesting #cybersecurity #infosec #appsec
